oro.note: Authored orographic control data. Not sampled from a DEM — these are the control curves and regions the height field is GENERATED from. Peaks are metres, `w` is falloff half-width in degrees. `regions` carry terrain TYPE, which drives micro-texture: dunes, salt flat, trap terracing, ravine badlands, delta and depression each get their own signature rather than a single slope-driven grain. See docs/09-procedural-map.md §3.
